mapper.select: SELECT A.STEP_CD, A.STEP, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT002', B.NTC_TYPE) AS NTC_TYPE_NM, B.NTC_TYPE, B.REQUIRED_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_APP APP WHERE APP.NTC_CD = B.NTC_CD AND APP.PASS_STEP = TO_CHAR(TO_NUMBER(A.STEP) + 1) AND APP.DEL_YN = 'N') AS QUALIFIED_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_APP APP WHERE APP.NTC_CD = B.NTC_CD AND APP.PASS_STEP = A.STEP AND APP.DEL_YN = 'N') AS UNQUALIFIED_CNT, C.FIELD_CD, C.COLLEGE_CD, FN_GET_DEPT_NM(C.COLLEGE_CD) AS COLLEGE_NM, C.DEPT_CD, FN_GET_DEPT_NM(C.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM, C.MAJOR_NM, C.STAFF_TYPE, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT004', C.STAFF_TYPE) AS STAFF_TYPE_NM FROM TB_NTC_STEP A INNER JOIN TB_NTC B ON A.NTC_CD = B.NTC_CD INNER JOIN TB_NTC_FIELD C ON B.NTC_CD = C.NTC_CD WHERE A.STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND A.NTC_CD = #{ntcCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.APP_CD, A.NM, F.COLLEGE_CD, FN_GET_DEPT_NM(F.COLLEGE_CD) AS COLLEGE_NM, F.DEPT_CD, FN_GET_DEPT_NM(F.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM, F.MAJOR_NM, F.STAFF_TYPE, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT004', F.STAFF_TYPE) AS STAFF_TYPE_NM, NVL(B.TOTAL_AVG, 0) AS TOTAL_AVG, NVL(B.EXCEPTED_AVG, 0) AS EXCEPTED_AVG, 0 AS RANK, A.PASS_STEP FROM TB_APP A LEFT JOIN TB_APP_USR U ON A.APP_USR_CD = U.APP_USR_CD INNER JOIN TB_EVAL_TOTAL_SCORE B ON A.APP_CD = B.APP_CD AND B.STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' INNER JOIN TB_NTC_FIELD F ON A.FIELD_CD = F.FIELD_CD INNER JOIN TB_NTC_STEP S ON S.STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND S.NTC_CD = F.NTC_CD AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND F.FIELD_CD = #{fieldCd} AND A.APP_STATUS = '3' AND ( A.PASS_STEP = #{step} OR A.PASS_STEP = TO_CHAR( TO_NUMBER(#{step}) + 1 ) ) ORDER BY EXCEPTED_AVG DESC, A.NM

SELECT A.JDG_CD AS USR_CD, A.JDG_DIV, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT011', A.JDG_DIV) AS JDG_DIV_NM, A.NM, A.CHAIR_YN, NVL(B.CONFIRMED_YN, 'N') AS CONFIRMED_YN, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(S.RESULT_SCORE), 0) FROM TB_EVAL_RESULT R INNER JOIN TB_EVAL_SCORE S ON R.RESULT_CD = S.RESULT_CD WHERE R.JDG_CD = A.JDG_CD AND R.APP_CD = #{appCd} AND R.CONFIRMED_YN = 'Y' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS TOTAL_SCORE, B.RESULT_CD FROM TB_SEL_EVAL_JDG A INNER JOIN TB_APP C ON C.APP_CD = #{appCd} LEFT JOIN TB_EVAL_RESULT B ON A.JDG_CD = B.JDG_CD AND B.APP_CD = #{appCd} AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE A.FIELD_CD = C.FIELD_CD AND A.STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.CONFIRMED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CHAIR_YN DESC, A.JDG_DIV, A.NM

SELECT R.RESULT_CD, J.NM AS JDG_NM, J.CHAIR_YN, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT011', J.JDG_DIV) AS JDG_DIV_NM, A.NM AS APP_NM, F.COLLEGE_CD, FN_GET_DEPT_NM(F.COLLEGE_CD) AS COLLEGE_NM, F.DEPT_CD, FN_GET_DEPT_NM(F.DEPT_CD) AS DEPT_NM, F.MAJOR_NM, F.STAFF_TYPE, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT004', F.STAFF_TYPE) AS STAFF_TYPE_NM, ( FN_GET_DEPT_NM(F.COLLEGE_CD) || ' ' || FN_GET_DEPT_NM(F.DEPT_CD) || ' ' || F.MAJOR_NM || ' ' || FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT004', F.STAFF_TYPE) ) AS FIELD_INFO, R.OPINION, R.MINUTES, R.CONFIRMED_YN FROM TB_EVAL_RESULT R INNER JOIN TB_SEL_EVAL_JDG J ON R.JDG_CD = J.JDG_CD INNER JOIN TB_APP A ON R.APP_CD = A.APP_CD INNER JOIN TB_NTC_FIELD F ON A.FIELD_CD = F.FIELD_CD WHERE R.RESULT_CD = #{resultCd} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND J.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT Q.QST_CD, Q.QST_TYPE, FN_GET_CODE_NM('RCT012', Q.QST_TYPE) AS QST_TYPE_NM, Q.QST_NM, Q.QST_SCORE, Q.IND_NM, Q.IND_SCORE, Q.SCORE_CRITERIA, S.RESULT_SCORE FROM TB_EVAL_RESULT R INNER JOIN TB_EVAL_SCORE S ON R.RESULT_CD = S.RESULT_CD INNER JOIN TB_EVAL_SHEET_QST Q ON S.QST_CD = Q.QST_CD WHERE R.RESULT_CD = #{resultCd} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' AND Q.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY Q.QST_TYPE, Q.SORT_ORDER, Q.QST_CD
